# 因Comet内容使用方式而建议屏蔽PerplexityBot

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-07-21 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1947176484021399870
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

@gofishchris @indexsy @MicoMartinez 4. @YoungbloodJoe 因为 Perplexity 的内容窃取计划，建议屏蔽它：https://x.com/YoungbloodJoe/status/1944866110467400014

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Joe Youngblood - SEO, Futurology, AI, Marketing @YoungbloodJoe](<https://x.com/YoungbloodJoe/status/1944866110467400014>)

更新：根据 @perplexity_ai 及其联合创始人对 Comet 浏览器的声明，以及该浏览器被设计成直接从你的网站窃取内容、却不给任何回报的运作方式，我们现在全面建议屏蔽用户代理 PerplexityBot。

我们会先将这项建议提供给出版类客户，接下来几周再向其他客户推广，除非 Perplexity 改变 Comet 的运作方式，或者同意做出这样的改变。

https://www.joeyoungblood.com/seo/blocking-bad-llm-bots-for-seo-performance/

- [所回复的帖子](<https://x.com/fba/status/1947176480934387860>)

## 英文原文

@gofishchris @indexsy @MicoMartinez 4. @YoungbloodJoe is recommending blocking Perplexity, due to content theft plans: https://x.com/YoungbloodJoe/status/1944866110467400014

### Quoted preview

[Joe Youngblood - SEO, Futurology, AI, Marketing @YoungbloodJoe](<https://x.com/YoungbloodJoe/status/1944866110467400014>)

Update: We now fully recommend blocking the user-agent PerplexityBot based on the statements by @perplexity_ai and their co-founders about their Comet browser and the way in which the browser is designed to directly steal content from your site and give back nothing. 

This recommendation is being shipped to publishing clients first and will be rolled out to other clients over the coming weeks unless Perplexity changes how Comet works or agrees to make such changes.

https://www.joeyoungblood.com/seo/blocking-bad-llm-bots-for-seo-performance/
